# Test inventory

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_test_inventory.py. Edit test code or the module purpose map, then regenerate. -->

This inventory is generated from the repository's test source, not maintained as a second list of test names. Every pytest-discoverable test function/method is listed individually. The host-driven scripts are listed separately because they launch KiCad/GUI/IPC processes and are intentionally executed by dedicated CI steps rather than collected by pytest.

## Pytest test cases

## Host-driven KiCad acceptance scripts

These files are named `test_*.py`, but expose executable `main()` acceptance harnesses rather than pytest test functions. CI invokes them explicitly with the KiCad runtime and (where required) a virtual display.

| Script | CI/local invocation | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/test_eeschema_gui.py` | `xvfb-run -a python tests/test_eeschema_gui.py` | Launches the real Eeschema editor, edits/publishes an implementation, synchronizes an existing local instance, saves, and verifies KiCad can re-parse the result. |
| `tests/test_instance_configuration_gui.py` | `python tests/test_instance_configuration_gui.py [--screenshot PATH]` | Drives the actual Tk instance-configuration form and checks saved schematic fields and the IPC transaction; also used to capture a documentation screenshot. |
| `tests/test_ipc_headless.py` | `python tests/test_ipc_headless.py` | Exercises real schematic IPC placement, instance configuration, facade identity, local-copy binding, nested composition, and saved-project invariants without an interactive window. |
| `tests/test_library_picker_gui.py` | `xvfb-run -a python tests/test_library_picker_gui.py` | Opens the real library picker, inspects native preview rendering and selection behavior, and validates the user-facing placement handoff. |
| `tests/test_pcb_ipc.py` | `python tests/test_pcb_ipc.py` | Uses real PCB IPC to create a board, assign/import nets and footprints, save, and reload native board objects. |
| `tests/test_pcb_layout.py` | `python tests/test_pcb_layout.py` | Runs end-to-end KiCad CLI/IPC board-layout merges and checks transformed footprints, tracks, vias, zones, graphics, namespaced nets/references, netclass mappings, and output safety. |
| `tests/test_plugin_registration.py` | `xvfb-run -a python tests/test_plugin_registration.py` | Starts KiCad, verifies plugin discovery and action registration, managed Python environment setup, and runs the configuration-form probe. |

## Supporting validation and evidence scripts

| Script | CI/local invocation | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/validate_kicad_cli.py` | `python tests/validate_kicad_cli.py` | Exports and validates generated schematic/PCB reference assets with the real KiCad CLI and checks structural/netlist expectations. |
| `tests/capture_visual_docs.py` | `xvfb-run -a python tests/capture_visual_docs.py --output-dir OUT` | Captures real light/dark KiCad plugin UI states, previews, modal workflows, and GIF/source evidence used by documentation and release publication. |

## Inventory maintenance

Run `python scripts/generate_test_inventory.py --write` after adding, renaming, or removing a test. CI runs `python scripts/generate_test_inventory.py --check` and fails when the committed inventory is stale. Update `MODULE_PURPOSES` when a test module's scope changes materially.
